mapper.sql: p.id, p.category_id, c.name AS category_name, p.name, p.subtitle, p.main_image, p.price, p.stock, p.sales, p.is_hot, p.status, p.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, name, subtitle, main_image, price, stock, sales, detail, is_hot, status) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{subtitle}, #{mainImage}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{detail}, #{isHot}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.is_hot = 1 ORDER BY p.sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id IN
#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET stock = stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET sales = sales + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET sales = GREATEST(sales - #{quantity}, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.stock <= #{threshold} ORDER BY p.stock ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY p.sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
